context: A teacher and a teen review a current-events project
purpose: Teach: 宮城/大島/荒川/金子/今井/市川/片山/熊谷

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、地方再生のテーマ、宮城の事例から始まる構成、いいですね。
lines.en: Sakura, I really like how you're structuring this—starting with the Miyagi cases for your regional-revival theme.
lines.style: Warm, genuinely impressed. Leans forward slightly. Nodding approval on 「いいですね」. Teacher voice but person-to-person, not lecturing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。大島の漁業協同組合、丁寧に取材しました。
lines.en: Yes. I did careful fieldwork on Oshima's fishing co-op.
lines.style: Earnest and direct. Quiet pride in the work done. Even pace, grounded. Small pause before responding—she's considered the question seriously.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 荒川流域の中小企業、金子さんが代表的なお話を聞かせてくれましたね。
lines.en: And the SMEs in the Arakawa basin—Kaneko-san really gave you some compelling stories to work with.
lines.style: Engaged, following the thread. Slightly rising inflection on 「お話」, recognizing the quality of her source work. Warm but observant—she's tracking something.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 今井家具店、市川での経営、家族の物語も入れました。
lines.en: The Imai Furniture shop in Ichikawa—I made sure to include the family history alongside the business side.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact with underlying care. She's explaining her choices, not defending them. Steady voice. Slight emphasis on 「物語も」—she knows this was the right call.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 片山地区、熊谷の若手起業家、最終章で取り上げます。
lines.en: Katayama district, the young entrepreneurs in Kumagaya—those will be your closing chapter.
lines.style: Reflective, measured. Looking ahead with quiet satisfaction. Slight exhale of completion in the trailing-off. Affirming without over-stating.
